description:
Cross-crate parallel to JMAP-231o.1 (calendars-client). 

crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/mod.rs:77 declares `updated: Option<HashMap<String, T>>`. RFC 8620 §5.3 (rfc8620.txt line 2043) types this as Id[Foo|null]|null — server returns null for a successfully updated object with no server-set deltas to report. serde fails to deserialize null into any concrete T (Email, Mailbox, etc.).

Same wire-protocol bug as JMAP-231o.1 with the same fix:
- value type: T → Option<T> (the |null arm of the spec union)
- key type: String → Id (spec wire type for updated keys)

Apply the same pair of regression tests with hand-written JSON oracles. See commit c89189d (calendars-client) for the reference implementation pattern.
title: SetResponse<T>.updated cannot deserialize per-id null values (mail-client)
